hero_background.description: Abstract dark gold curves for hero background overlay

hero_person.description: Man in black suit and sunglasses, ideal for bodyguard representation

recruitment_hero.description: Man in uniform for recruitment page

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Buttons and links must have contrasting hover colors (e.g., gold to lighter gold). Cards should lift slightly (-translate-y-1) and increase border opacity.
motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: Fade in sections on scroll using framer-motion.
motion_and_interactions.loading: Subtle gold spinner or pulsing logo.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over images has dark overlays (bg-black/60) to maintain contrast.
accessibility.aria_labels: All interactive elements must include data-testid attribute in kebab-case format based on role (e.g., data-testid='hero-download-btn').

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the website as a multi-page React application (or React Router based single app) with pages: Home, Become a Guard, About, Contact.
Use Cabinet Grotesk for headings and Satoshi for body text. Add Fontshare CDN link in index.html to load these fonts.
Install and use @phosphor-icons/react for all icons (Duotone weight preferred).
Install framer-motion for scroll animations and transitions.
Implement a sticky header with a glassmorphism effect (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0B0B0D]/80). Navigation should not be hidden behind a hamburger on desktop.
Hero section should use 'hero_background' as a background image with heavy dark overlay, and optionally 'hero_person' placed aesthetically.
App Store / Play Store download CTAs should be solid gold buttons acting as placeholders ('Coming Soon').
Trust strip should be a subtle grid or flex row below the hero with gold text and icons.
Use the Bento Grid layout strategy for the 'Use Cases' section. Prefer pure HTML/Tailwind over generic Shadcn sections to achieve a unique premium feel.
Footer must include the specified links (Privacy Policy, Terms, DPDP consent), serviceable cities (Delhi NCR), and contact email (contactus@therakshak.in).
All components and interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes for testing.
Ensure strict adherence to the premium dark + gold theme (#0B0B0D background, #D9A93D gold).
